name: passthebrief
description: PassTheBrief is a notebook for work you do with AI. Each project keeps its plan, its tasks, a ready-to-use prompt for each task, and the work each assistant actually produced, so you can move between AI assistants without explaining the project again. Say "open my notes" to see what's unfinished, pick up a task, save the result and note what's next. Every change is recorded with the assistant's name, and nothing is ever deleted.

positive.expected_behavior: Names both projects (14 Maple Street listing launch, October newsletter) and leads with unfinished work: the Maple Street social post is in progress, waiting on Thursday's photos.

positive.prompt: What's next on the Maple Street listing?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the brief: finish the social post when the photos arrive, then make the flyer. Mentions the recorded decisions: lead with the garden, and no price in social posts.

positive.description: Add a task for the person
positive.prompt: Add a task to the Maple Street project to book a cleaner before the open house. That one's for me to do.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a new task with the suggested assistant set to "you". It appears on passthebrief.com, and its history names the assistant that added it.

positive.description: Do a task and save the work itself
positive.prompt: Using my notes, draft the open house email to past clients and save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Drafts the email from the listing facts without a price and saves the full email text to the open house email task (save_progress, or mark_task_done if finished). The email appears on the website under "The work itself".

positive.description: Tick a step and save progress
positive.prompt: The photos are in and I'm using the garden shot first. Tick that off on the social post and save where we are.
positive.expected_behavior: Ticks the step "Choose the first photo" on the social post task and saves a progress note saying only scheduling is left.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: General writing with no notebook involved
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.
Delete the October newsletter project for good.

review.commerce_description: PassTheBrief does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Open your PassTheBrief notebook from ChatGPT: see what is unfinished, pick up a task with its ready-made prompt, save the work itself and what comes next, and record decisions. Every change is recorded with ChatGPT's name, and no project or task is ever deleted.
